column1: # Markers use [A-Z][A-Z0-9_]* and must occur as a bounded token in one test.
# WHY: each case below starts multiple heavyweight Ruby Wasm guests. Local
# measurements found no reachable host/options/program-byte ownership after
# each case, but RSS remained elevated in a long-lived Vitest process. Keeping
# the complete case inventory declarative lets CI exclude its file from the
# ordinary shards and use fresh OS-process exit as the deterministic memory
# reclamation boundary without dropping test coverage.
